title: Pigs Plus
description: This mod adds a Golden Carrot on a Stick that allows for faster pig transportation speeds and swimming while riding a pig. It also adds the ability to breed and heal pigs with golden carrots.
body:
# Before Horses, there were Pigs

Before horses, there were pigs. Pigs Plus updates the long-forgotten ability to ride pigs by adding a Golden Carrot on a Stick for faster pig transportation, the ability to swim while riding a pig, and more. 

![Player Riding a Pig with a Golden Carrot on a Stick](https://xavdigital.com/minecraft/pigsplus/me-and-my-bro.png)

## Features

- Golden Carrot on a Stick - A faster alternative to the carrot on a stick, also with much higher durability.
![Golden Carrot on a Stick in an Item Frame](https://xavdigital.com/minecraft/pigsplus/item-frame.png)
- Swim while riding a pig by using the Golden Carrot on a Stick.
![Player Riding a Pig in the Ocean at night](https://xavdigital.com/minecraft/pigsplus/late-night-swim.png)
- Pigs can now breed & heal using golden carrots.
![Heard of Pigs Rushing Player with Golden Carrot](https://xavdigital.com/minecraft/pigsplus/thats-a-lot-of-pigs.png)
- [Coming Soon] Pig Armor
